detailed_description: Midjourney Prompt Generator - Create structured prompt variants from a subject, visual style, lighting note, composition, aspect ratio, and optional exclusions. The generator combines those inputs into several copy-ready prompt lines with --ar aspect ratio syntax and an optional --no block, helping image creators compare phrasing directions before using the prompt in their own workflow.
usage_steps: Describe the subject, style, lighting, and composition you want
Pick an aspect ratio and add any negative prompt terms if needed
Review the generated prompt variants and option rows
Copy the full set or one variant, then refine it in your image workflow
usage_examples: Generate six prompt angles for an editorial workspace scene
Compare square, widescreen, and vertical aspect ratio prompts
Add exclusions for unwanted visual elements before testing a prompt

faqs.question: Is the Midjourney Prompt Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The generator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does this create images?
faqs.answer: No. It creates text prompt variants only. Use the copied prompt in the image tool or creative workflow you choose.

faqs.question: What does the negative prompt field do?
faqs.answer: If you enter exclusions, the generator appends them as a --no block in each prompt variant.
